name: hud_ui_main_menu_dialog_constructor
description: HudUiMainMenuDialog::Constructor initializes the HUD background, selects frontend/in-game menu routes, binds main-menu widgets, and refreshes load/save availability.
known_limits: The in-game MAINMENU3/MAINMENU1 selection is spelled as explicit source branches and the VC listing emits separate LoadFromZrd calls for those sections, matching the retail branch shape.
The smoke covers route selection and save/load availability through the typed C++ class model; obsolete custom FTable global identity assertions are intentionally not used.
Current VC5 byte comparison remains below tier S with codegen/scheduling differences after the source-faithful class owner recovery.
